title: Follow-up: #38 round-2 documentation and spec corrections
description: Groups the remaining round-2 review findings from opum-ai/glyph-cli#38, all documentation or spec correctness, none behavioural today. (2) MINOR: the README impact transcript prints the old line 'unresolved: 0 of 3 call site(s) did not resolve', while src/program.ts prints 'coverage (index-wide): 3 resolved call site(s); 0 call-shaped site(s) did not resolve'; the CLI test already pins the real text. (3) MINOR: src/impact.ts's header comment and the module-scope test name still say 'one-site path', the (a1) wording that DEC-216 (a2) replaced; the code emits the full path and the test asserts a two-site path, so a reader of the file would think it violates its own ruling. (4) MINOR: ADR 0003 and the README say two machines with different installs answer identically and that a fully dirty checkout cannot influence a --ref answer, and cache.ts says the SHA and the index format 'determine the derived index'; but every outside-root path goes to ts.sys (hoisted dependency tree, parent tsconfig reached by extends, the TypeScript lib) and computeRefKey includes none of it, so a hoisted install or an edited parent tsconfig can change a cold answer while a warm cache keeps the old one. (5) NIT: posix() in snapshot.ts rewrites backslashes in git ls-tree paths, which mangles a legal POSIX filename containing a backslash so indexer.ts silently skips it; drop it on git output or make it win32-only. (6) NIT: 'in-repo node_modules is not read from disk' is absolute while the running TypeScript package's own lib directory is served from disk even inside the analyzed repo; reword. (7) NIT: README 'Paths inside the tree that it does not contain are invisible' is garbled; intended 'inside the repository'. NIT 8 (CLAUDE.md exit family) is already GCLI-16.
plan: Fix the README impact transcript to the coverage line src/program.ts actually prints.
Reword the impact.ts header comment and the module-scope test name to true depth with the full path, citing DEC-216 (a1) as amended by (a2).
Scope the ADR 0003, README and cache.ts identity claims to in-repo content, naming the outside-root host reads the ref cache key does not hash; the design arm (hashing them) stays open for opum-doc.
Make posix() win32-only so git ls-tree paths keep a legal backslash, add a ref-snapshot test, and file the remaining TypeScript normalisation limit as GCLI-30.
Fix wording 6 and 7; run lore validate/check and bun run check.
